title: refAInery work request v1
description: Immutable prompt-based intake record. Queue and execution state are stored separately. This record must not contain credentials.

id.description: Application-assigned stable request identity, unique within storage. Uniqueness is enforced by the storage writer, not this schema.

prompt.description: Original requested work, preserved without trimming or rewriting. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

receivedAt.description: Application-recorded receipt time in UTC, using uppercase T and Z. Validators must enable date-time format assertions.

source.description: Intake source. V1 initially supports manual requests only; additional sources require an explicit contract update.
